senses.gloss:
गौर गौर, अस्, ई, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 3. गु),
white, yellowish, reddish, pale red; shining, brilliant,
pure, clean, beautiful; (अस्), m. white, yellowish, &c.
(the colour); a kind of buffalo, the Bos Gaurus,
often classed with the Gavaya; white mustard, the
seed of it used as a weight, = 3 Rāja-sarṣapas [cf.
गौर-सर्षप]; the plant Grislea Tomentosa
(= धव); the moon; the planet Jupiter; N.
of a Yoga teacher, a son of Śuka and Pīvarī; an
epithet of the saint Caitanya; (ई), f. the female of
the Bos Gaurus; the Vāc or voice of the middle
region of the air; turmeric, = रजनी, and N. of
several other plants, = प्रियङ्गु, मञ्जिष्ठा, &c.;
a yellow pigment or dye, = गो-रोचना; a girl eight
years old, any young girl prior to menstruation, a
maid, a virgin; the earth; ‘the brilliant goddess,’
N. of the goddess Pārvatī or daughter of Himālaya
and wife of Śiva; N. of the wife of Varuṇa; N. of
the mother of Śākya-muni [cf. माया]; N. of one
of the sixteen Vidyā-devīs; N. of the wife of Prasena-
jit (or Yuvanāśva), who incurring the curse of her
husband was changed into the river Bāhu-dā; N. of
the wife of Vi-rajas and mother of Su-dhāman; N. of a
river; N. of a Rāgiṇī, the wife of the Rāga Mālava;
N. of several metres, one consisting of four lines of
twelve syllables each; another consisting of four lines
of thirteen syllables each; another consisting of four
lines of twenty-six long syllables each; (अम्), n.
white mustard; the filament of a lotus; saffron;
gold; [cf. Lat. gilvus; Lith. geltônas, giele; Russ.
schiltyi; Germ. gelb ?].
—गौर-खर, अस्, m.
a wild donkey; [cf. गौडक-मृग.]
—गौर-
ग्रीव, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people in Madhya-deśa.
—गौरग्रीवीय, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to this
people.
—गौर-चन्द्र, अस्, m. an epithet of the
saint Caitanya.
—गौर-जीरक, अस्, m. white cumin.
—गौर-तित्तिरि, इस्, m. a kind of partridge.
—गौर-
त्वच्, क्, m. the plant Terminalia Catappa; [cf.
इङ्गुद.]
—गौर-पृष्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
—गौर-मुख, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śamīka,
a Purohita of king Ugra-sena.
—गौर-मृग, अस्,
m., Ved. the Bos Gaurus.
—गौर-वाहन, अस्, m.,
N. of a prince.
—गौर-शाक, अस्, m., N. of a plant,
a kind of Madhūka.
—गौर-शिरस्, आस्, m., N. of a
Muni.
—गौर-सर्षप, अस्, m. white mustard,
Sinapis Glauca; the white mustard seed considered
as a measure of weight.
—गौर-सुवर्ण, अम्, n.
a kind of vegetable; [cf. पत्त्रशाक-विशेष, =
कटु-शृङ्गाल and गन्ध-शाक.]
—गौराङ्ग
(˚र-अङ्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of the saint Caitanya;
[cf. गौर and गौर-चन्द्र.]
—गौराजाजी (˚र-
अज्˚), f. white cumin.
—गौरार्द्रक (˚र-आर्˚), अस्,
m. a kind of poison.
—गौरावस्कन्दिन् (˚र-अव्˚),
ई, m. an epithet of Indra.
—गौराश्व (˚र-अश्˚), अस्,
m., N. of a prince.
—गौरास्य (˚र-आस्˚), अस्, m. a
kind of black monkey with a white face.
—गौरा-
हिक (˚र-अहि), अस्, m. a kind of serpent.
—गौरि-
वीति, इस्, m. (for गौरी-व्˚), N. of a Ṛṣi, a descend-
ant of Śakti.
—गौरी-कल्प, अस्, m., N. of a Kalpa,
the thirteenth day of the dark half in Brahmā's
month.
—गौरी-कान्त, अस्, m., N. of a commentator
on the Tarka-bhāṣā.
—गौरीकान्त-सार्वभौम,
अस्, m., N. of a commentary called Ānanda-laharī-
tarī.
—गौरी-गुरु, उस्, m. the father of Gaurī, an
epithet of the Himālaya.
—गौरी-ज, अस्, m. an
epithet of Kārttikeya; (अम्), n. talc.
—गौरी-नाथ,
[]
अस्, m. the husband of Gaurī, an epithet of Śiva.
—गौरी-पट्ट, अस्, m. the horizontal plate of the
Liṅga, typical of the female organ.
—गौरी-पति, इस्,
m. the husband of Gaurī, an epithet of Śiva; N. of
the father of the scholiast Vaṭeśvara.
—गौरी-पुत्र,
अस्, m. son of Gaurī, an epithet of the deity Kārtti-
keya.
—गौरी-पुष्प, अस्, m., N. of a plant, =
गौरी or प्रियङ्गु.
—गौरी-पूजा, f. the adoration
of Gaurī, N. of a festival on the fourth day in the
last half of month Māgha.
—गौरी-भर्तृ, ता, m.
the husband of Gaurī, an epithet of Śiva.
—गौरी-
मन्त्र, अस्, m. a prayer to Gaurī.
—गौरी-ललित,
अम्, n. yellow orpiment.
—गौरी-वर, अस्, m. the
lover of Gaurī, an epithet of Śiva.
—गौरीवित,
अम्, n. (fr. गौरि-वीति, q. v.), N. of a Sāman.
—गौरी-
विवाह, अस्, m. the marriage of Gaurī.
—गौरी-
व्रत, अम्, n. the vow of Gaurī, a kind of rite in
honour of Gaurī.
—गौरीश (˚री-ईश), अस्, m. the
lord of Gaurī, an epithet of Śiva.

गौरिक, अस्, m. white mustard; a metronymic
of Māndhātṛ; (आ), f. a virgin, a young girl, one
eight years old or in whom menstruation has not yet
commenced.

गौरिल, अस्, m. white mustard; iron or steel
filings or dust.

गौरक्ष्य गौरक्ष्य, अम्, n. (fr. गो-रक्ष),
the office of a herdsman, breeding cattle.

गौरव गौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गुरु), relating
or belonging to a Guru or teacher; (अम्), n. weight,
heaviness; length in prosody; importance, high value
or estimation; cumbrousness; gravity, respectability,
venerableness; dignity; respect shown to a person
(e. g. मातृ-गौरवात्, out of respect for one's
mother).
—गौरव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, important.
—गौरवासन (˚व-आस्˚), अम्, n. a seat of honour.
—गौरवेरित (˚व-ईर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, praised, famed,
celebrated.

गौरवित, अस्, आ, अम्, highly esteemed or valued,
venerable, respectable.
गौरि गौरि, इस्, m., N. of a man.

गौरुतल्पिक गौरुतल्पिक, अस्, m. (fr. गुरु-
तल्प), the violator of the bed of a Guru or religious
preceptor.
